lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid-like array of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately 10-12 vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with higher spot density and smaller radii appearing towards the anterior head region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of spots, creating a geometric checkerboard lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges extending longitudinally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with specular highlights on the dorsal-facing edge and deep shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense concentration of small, high-contrast circular blobs on the visible left pectoral fin, significantly smaller in diameter than the primary flank spots.
